enchantments.tooltip: Purifying Flame Lore +14: Passive: Your Fire and Light spells gain a +14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Flaming Blast 4: This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.
Coruscating 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 4d6 Light damage on each hit.
Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
